calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS first_period, 4 AS last_period)
SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement: SELECT count(*) AS receipts_multi_store FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY receipt_id HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)

WITH a AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) n, sum(receipts) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(a.n) mine, sum(b.n) ctrl, sum(a.n)-sum(b.n) diff, sum(a.r) r_mine, sum(b.r) r_ctrl, sum(CASE WHEN abs(a.n-b.n)>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatched
FROM a FULL JOIN b USING (store_id)
